description: A ground-level photograph depicts an agricultural field featuring multiple rows of young green trees or shrubs. The plants are evenly spaced and grow in dark, tilled soil. The sky above is bright, indicating daylight. In the distant background, blurred outlines of more mature trees and general vegetation are visible. The plants appear to be young permanent crops, consistent with descriptions of pistachio trees or willow plantations found in the surrounding document context.
